name: @cintelisai/adsoptimiser-mcp

tools.name: adsoptimiser_connect
tools.description: Start signing in to Ads Optimiser (OAuth device flow). Returns a URL and a code for the user to approve in their browser, where they also choose the workspace; afterwards call adsoptimiser_finish_connect.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_finish_connect
tools.description: Complete a pending Ads Optimiser sign-in after the user has approved it in the browser.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_status
tools.description: Show whether this machine is connected to Ads Optimiser, as which user, to which workspace and with what role.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_disconnect
tools.description: Revoke this machine's Ads Optimiser token and delete it from this machine.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_list_models
tools.description: List the image and video models available for generation with their modes, aspect ratios, resolutions, quality options and indicative cost. Call this before choosing a non-default model.

asset_type.description: Only list image or video models.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_enhance_prompt
tools.description: Expand a rough idea into a detailed prompt tuned for TikTok ad creatives. Returns text only; nothing is generated and no allowance is used.

language.description: Language of the rough prompt. The result is always English.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_generate_image
tools.description: Generate an ad image with Grok (or OpenAI GPT Image 2.5, or Luma, where enabled; see adsoptimiser_list_models). If Grok fails upstream the server may retry once on GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst; the result then says so. Uses one image generation from the workspace's monthly plan allowance. Usually returns the finished image URL with a small preview so you can check it; if it takes longer, returns the job id to check with adsoptimiser_get_job. To edit or restyle existing images pass reference_image_paths (local files, uploaded for you), reference_image_urls or reference_job_ids. For an AI influencer, first generate a character sheet (the same person from several angles, a full-body shot and a close-up, neutral white background, realistic unretouched skin), save the best shots with adsoptimiser_create_character, then pass character_id to place that person in new scenes (porch, kitchen, garden...).

model.description: Model id from adsoptimiser_list_models. Defaults to grok-imagine-image-2.0. Also: grok-imagine-image (fastest Grok), gpt-image-2.5-sunburst (OpenAI, follows detailed specs closely) and gpt-image-2.5-flare (OpenAI, fast) where the deployment offers them.

aspect_ratio.description: For example 9:16 (TikTok vertical), 1:1 or 16:9. See adsoptimiser_list_models for all values (OpenAI models take 1:1, 2:3, 9:16, 3:2, 16:9 or auto).

resolution.description: Grok models only. OpenAI models size the image from aspect_ratio.

quality.description: Grok Image 2.0: low (fastest, about 13s), medium or auto (45 to 50s); no high. OpenAI models: low, medium (default), high or auto. grok-imagine-image takes none.

reference_image_paths.description: Local image files (absolute paths; png, jpg, webp or gif, max 10 MB each) to upload and edit or use as references.

reference_image_urls.description: Images to edit or use as references (https URLs, for example media_url values).

reference_job_ids.description: Finished image jobs to use as references instead of URLs.

character_id.description: Keep a saved character consistent: its images are added as references (5 in total with reference_image_paths/reference_image_urls/reference_job_ids) and its description is added to the prompt.

wait.description: Wait briefly for the finished image (default true). false returns the job id at once.

include_thumbnails.description: Attach small preview images (384px JPEG) of the finished image, when it is ready in time so you can see them. Default true.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_generate_video
tools.description: Start an ad video generation (text-to-video, or image-to-video from source_image_path, source_image_url or source_job_id). Uses one video generation from the plan allowance and counts toward the daily video quota. Returns immediately with a job id; videos take one to several minutes, so check progress with adsoptimiser_get_job. For a consistent AI influencer pass character_id: with script (the exact words) and no source image you get a 9:16 talking-to-camera clip in the character's voice (talking videos speak xAI preset voices; for a designed OpenAI voice or a cloned ElevenLabs voice, generate a clip at 720p where the character faces the camera with the mouth closed and does not speak (no script), then follow with adsoptimiser_lip_sync); for silent b-roll, animate a scene image of the character (source_job_id from adsoptimiser_generate_image with character_id) and add on-screen text with adsoptimiser_add_overlays or a pipeline's add_captions step.

prompt.description: What should happen in the video.

resolution.description: Defaults to 720p. 1080p is Grok Video 1.5 only and costs about 3x more.

source_image_path.description: Animate this local image (absolute path; image-to-video). It is uploaded first.

source_job_id.description: Animate the image from this finished image job.

voice_ids.description: Preset voices (Grok Video 1.5, text-to-video, max 720p). Tag speech in the prompt as <AUDIO_0>..<AUDIO_2>. Omit to use the character's default voice.

character_id.description: A saved character to star in the video. Without a source image: reference-to-video on Grok Video 1.5 (max 720p) with up to 3 of its images. With a source image: that image stays the first frame and only the character's description is added.

script.description: The exact line spoken to camera (talking video, Grok Video 1.5, text-to-video, max 720p). The voice is voice_ids, else the character's default voice, else eve.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_lip_sync
tools.description: Make the person in an existing video say a new line in a designed voice: the script is spoken (a cloned ElevenLabs voice, an OpenAI voice with instructions, or an xAI preset; by default the character's own voice) and the mouth is re-animated to match (Kling LipSync by default, or Sync LipSync 2 Pro with model sync-lipsync-2-pro for the best lips, on fal.ai). The source is a finished video job, an https URL or a local .mp4/.mov file (video_path, max 100 MB, uploaded for you). Results are best on a clip where the person faces the camera with the mouth closed and still, not already talking. Kling's limits: the clip must be 2 to 10 seconds at 720p or 1080p (generate it at 720p, not 480p). With either model the speech must fit the clip at about 15 characters a second (about 20 words for an 8 second clip). Uses one video generation from the plan allowance and counts toward the daily video quota (about US$0.014 per 5 seconds of clip). Returns a job id at once; it takes 2 to 5 minutes, so follow it with adsoptimiser_get_job. For a whole character talking clip in one go, run the character-lip-sync template with adsoptimiser_run_pipeline.

video_job_id.description: A finished video job to lip-sync (from adsoptimiser_generate_video; 2-10s at 720p or 1080p for Kling).

video_url.description: Or an https URL of an .mp4/.mov clip.

video_path.description: Or a local .mp4/.mov clip (absolute path, max 100 MB), uploaded for you. Pass exactly one of video_job_id, video_url or video_path.

script.description: The exact words the person says. It must fit the clip: about 15 characters a second (an 8s clip fits about 120 characters, about 20 words).

voice.description: Voice to speak in (adsoptimiser_list_voices). Omit to use character_id's voice, else the voice of the character the video was made from, else eve.

voice_id.description: xAI preset (adsoptimiser_list_voices), e.g. eve, leo, rex.

instructions.description: How to speak: accent, emotion, intonation, pacing, tone, e.g. 'slow, warm, gravelly, rural American accent'.

xai_voice_id.description: xAI preset talking videos use for this character (they cannot speak OpenAI voices). Default eve.

voice_id.description: A cloned voice listed for this workspace by adsoptimiser_list_voices (ElevenLabs voice id, e.g. a real person's voice).

xai_voice_id.description: xAI preset talking videos use for this character (they cannot speak ElevenLabs voices). Default eve.

character_id.description: Speak in this saved character's voice when voice is omitted.

model.description: Lip-sync model: kling-lipsync (the default, about US$0.014 per 5 seconds; 2 to 10 second clips at 720p or 1080p) or sync-lipsync-2-pro (best mouth and teeth fidelity, about US$5 per minute, about US$0.70 for an 8 second clip; any resolution, clips up to 60 seconds). Use sync-lipsync-2-pro when the lips must look right, e.g. a real person's face.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_add_overlays
tools.description: Burn timed text into ANY finished video: title cards or caption lines shown at set times (cues), and/or captions timed to the speech (auto_captions). It works on any video you already have (a finished job, a pipeline's output, an upload): there is no need to regenerate the video or run a pipeline to caption or re-caption it. The source is a finished video job, an https URL, or a local .mp4/.mov (video_path, max 120 MB, uploaded for you); pass exactly one. Each cue is { text (1 to 200 characters), start, end (seconds from the start, 0 <= start < end), position? (top, center, bottom), style? (caption or card), y?, size?, max_width? }, at most 50. Placement: y (0.05 to 0.95) is the vertical centre of the text as a fraction of frame height (0 is the top) and overrides position; size is small, medium, large (default medium for a caption, large for a card); max_width (0.4 to 1) is the text block's width as a fraction of frame width. In 9:16 talking clips keep cards out of the upper third, where the face is: use y 0.62 or position "center". For two short lines, put \n in the text (at most 3 lines). Example, grade cards timed to spoken moments: the presenter says "maths, an A" at about 2 seconds and "science, a B plus" at about 5, so cues [{ "text": "Maths: A", "start": 2, "end": 4.5, "style": "card", "y": 0.62 }, { "text": "Science\nB+", "start": 5, "end": 7.5, "style": "card", "position": "center", "size": "large" }]. Time cards from what you know of the clip; speech runs about 15 characters a second. Use auto_captions when the video has speech and every word should be captioned as it is said: the server transcribes it (whisper-1, about US$0.006 per minute) and adds word-timed caption chunks (captions_position, default bottom, or captions_y; captions_size small, medium or large). Pass script when you know the words (for example the line given to adsoptimiser_lip_sync or adsoptimiser_generate_video): it corrects the transcript's spellings of names, brands and numbers. Cues and auto_captions combine. Everything is checked on this machine first, so a bad request fails before anything is sent or charged. Rendering counts as one creative job, not a generation. Returns a job id at once; follow it with adsoptimiser_get_job.

video_job_id.description: A finished video job to add the text to.

video_url.description: Or an https URL of an .mp4/.mov video.

video_path.description: Or a local .mp4/.mov video (absolute path, max 120 MB), uploaded for you. Pass exactly one of video_job_id, video_url or video_path.

cues.description: Timed text, at most 50 cues: [{ text, start, end, position?, style?, y?, size?, max_width? }], each shown from start to end (seconds). position is top, center, bottom; style is caption or card; y (0.05 to 0.95) overrides position; size is small, medium, large; max_width is 0.4 to 1. text may hold \n line breaks, at most 3 lines.

text.description: The words to show, 1 to 200 characters. Use \n for a line break (at most 3 lines), for example two short lines.

start.description: When it appears: seconds from the start of the video, 0 or more.

end.description: When it goes: seconds from the start, after start.

position.description: Where it sits: top, center, bottom.

style.description: caption (a subtitle line) or card (a bold title card).

y.description: Vertical centre of the text as a fraction of frame height, 0.05 to 0.95 (0 is the top); overrides position. In a 9:16 talking clip keep cards below the face, for example 0.62.

size.description: Text size: small, medium, large. Default medium for a caption, large for a card.

max_width.description: Width of the text block as a fraction of frame width, 0.4 to 1.

auto_captions.description: Transcribe the video's speech (whisper-1, about US$0.006 per minute) and add captions timed to the words as they are spoken. Pass cues, auto_captions true, or both.

captions_position.description: Where auto captions sit: top, center, bottom. Default bottom.

captions_y.description: Vertical centre of the auto captions as a fraction of frame height, 0.05 to 0.95 (0 is the top); overrides captions_position.

captions_size.description: Size of the auto captions: small, medium, large. Default medium.

script.description: The known script, if you have it: used to correct the transcript's spellings (names, brands, numbers) in auto captions.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_get_job
tools.description: Get the status of an image or video job, with the result URL once it is ready (statuses: queued, generating, ready, failed, expired). Lip-sync and overlay jobs say what they did (an overlay job: its cue count, auto captions, transcript words and transcription cost). A finished image (or a video with a stored poster frame) comes with a small preview image so you can see it.

include_thumbnails.description: Attach small preview images (384px JPEG) of the finished image (or a video's poster frame) so you can see them. Default true.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_list_jobs
tools.description: List recent image and video jobs in the workspace, newest first. Filter by status or asset type. Pass include_thumbnails to see small previews of up to 6 finished jobs, e.g. to pick the best results.

include_thumbnails.description: Attach small preview images (384px JPEG) of up to 6 finished jobs (images, and videos with a poster frame) so you can see them. Default false.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_list_pipelines
tools.description: List pipeline templates and the workspace's saved pipelines that adsoptimiser_run_pipeline can start. To design a new pipeline, start with adsoptimiser_get_pipeline_nodes.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_run_pipeline
tools.description: Start a pipeline run from exactly one of: a template_id or saved graph_id (see adsoptimiser_list_pipelines), or an unsaved graph. An inline graph must use only node types from adsoptimiser_get_pipeline_nodes, keep to 12 nodes, and should pass adsoptimiser_validate_pipeline first; it is validated again here and not run if invalid. Local image paths in input_image nodes and local video paths in input_video nodes are uploaded for you. character_id fills every character step that has none (required by templates marked needs_character). video_job_id, video_url or video_path fills every empty input_video step (required by templates marked needs_video, such as video-recaption). Each generation step uses plan allowance like a single job (video steps also count toward the daily video quota), so confirm with the user before running. Returns the run id, step count and estimated provider cost; check progress with adsoptimiser_get_pipeline_run.

template_id.description: A template id from adsoptimiser_list_pipelines, for example product-ad.

graph_id.description: A saved pipeline id from adsoptimiser_list_pipelines.

graph.description: An unsaved pipeline graph to run as is. Check it with adsoptimiser_validate_pipeline first. Pass exactly one of template_id, graph_id or graph.

id.description: Unique node id: 1 to 40 letters, digits or underscores.

type.description: A node type from adsoptimiser_get_pipeline_nodes. Never invent one.

params.description: Params for this node type, from adsoptimiser_get_pipeline_nodes. input_image takes image_url: an https URL or an absolute local file path (uploaded for you). input_video takes exactly one of video_job_id, video_url (the workspace's /media URL) or video_path (an absolute local .mp4/.mov, uploaded for you).

edges.description: Connections from an output of one node to an input of another, of the same kind.

node.description: Unique node id: 1 to 40 letters, digits or underscores.
Unique node id: 1 to 40 letters, digits or underscores.

prompt.description: The run prompt. Required unless every step gets its prompt elsewhere.

character_id.description: Fills every character step that has no character chosen. Required for templates marked needs_character (character-talking-clip, character-scene, character-lip-sync).

video_job_id.description: For a template or saved pipeline marked needs_video: a ready video job in this workspace that fills every empty input_video step. Give at most one of video_job_id, video_url or video_path.

video_url.description: The same as video_job_id, as the workspace's own /media URL.

video_path.description: The same as video_job_id, as a local .mp4 or .mov that is checked and uploaded for you first.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_get_pipeline_run
tools.description: Get a pipeline run's status and each step's status, job id and result URL.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_get_pipeline_nodes
tools.description: Get the pipeline node catalogue: every node type with its inputs (kind, required, max connections), outputs, params (allowed values and ranges) and rules, plus the graph rules (at most 12 nodes, edge format, how the run prompt feeds unwired prompt inputs) and a worked example graph. Always call this before designing or changing a pipeline graph, and use only the node types, ports and params it lists; never invent node types. Uses no allowance.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_get_pipeline
tools.description: Get a saved pipeline's graph (nodes, edges and params), name and estimated cost per run, for example to change it and save it again with adsoptimiser_save_pipeline and its graph_id.

graph_id.description: A saved pipeline id from adsoptimiser_list_pipelines or adsoptimiser_save_pipeline.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_validate_pipeline
tools.description: Check a pipeline graph without running or saving it: reports whether it is valid, each problem with the node ids involved, the node count (at most 12), the estimated provider cost per run, and whether running it needs a prompt. Uses no allowance. Always validate before adsoptimiser_save_pipeline or adsoptimiser_run_pipeline with a graph; build graphs only from adsoptimiser_get_pipeline_nodes. Local image paths in input_image nodes and local video paths in input_video nodes are uploaded, and the returned graph has them replaced with hosted URLs: pass that graph on to save or run.

id.description: Unique node id: 1 to 40 letters, digits or underscores.

type.description: A node type from adsoptimiser_get_pipeline_nodes. Never invent one.

params.description: Params for this node type, from adsoptimiser_get_pipeline_nodes. input_image takes image_url: an https URL or an absolute local file path (uploaded for you). input_video takes exactly one of video_job_id, video_url (the workspace's /media URL) or video_path (an absolute local .mp4/.mov, uploaded for you).

edges.description: Connections from an output of one node to an input of another, of the same kind.

node.description: Unique node id: 1 to 40 letters, digits or underscores.
Unique node id: 1 to 40 letters, digits or underscores.

graph.description: A pipeline graph: { version: 1, nodes: [{ id, type, params }], edges: [{ from: { node, output }, to: { node, input } }] }. See adsoptimiser_get_pipeline_nodes.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_save_pipeline
tools.description: Save a pipeline graph to the workspace (or update one when graph_id is given) so it can be run later with adsoptimiser_run_pipeline and edited in the app's pipeline editor. Build it only from node types in adsoptimiser_get_pipeline_nodes, keep to 12 nodes, and check it with adsoptimiser_validate_pipeline first; an invalid graph is refused with its errors. Local image paths in input_image nodes and local video paths in input_video nodes are uploaded for you. Saving uses no allowance.

name.description: Name shown in the app's pipeline list.

id.description: Unique node id: 1 to 40 letters, digits or underscores.

type.description: A node type from adsoptimiser_get_pipeline_nodes. Never invent one.

params.description: Params for this node type, from adsoptimiser_get_pipeline_nodes. input_image takes image_url: an https URL or an absolute local file path (uploaded for you). input_video takes exactly one of video_job_id, video_url (the workspace's /media URL) or video_path (an absolute local .mp4/.mov, uploaded for you).

edges.description: Connections from an output of one node to an input of another, of the same kind.

node.description: Unique node id: 1 to 40 letters, digits or underscores.
Unique node id: 1 to 40 letters, digits or underscores.

graph.description: A pipeline graph: { version: 1, nodes: [{ id, type, params }], edges: [{ from: { node, output }, to: { node, input } }] }. See adsoptimiser_get_pipeline_nodes.

graph_id.description: Update this saved pipeline instead of creating a new one.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_list_characters
tools.description: List the workspace's saved characters (consistent AI people such as influencers or brand ambassadors) with their reference images, description, style and default voice. Use a character_id with adsoptimiser_generate_image, adsoptimiser_generate_video or adsoptimiser_run_pipeline to keep the same person across scenes and videos.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_get_character
tools.description: Get one saved character with every reference image URL (and the job each came from), its description, style and default voice, plus a summary of everything made with it: counts per kind, the latest items (with any kept speech audio) and the latest voice previews. Use adsoptimiser_list_character_assets for the full gallery, and its download_to to save files locally. Small previews of the reference images are attached so you can see the character.

character_id.description: A character id from adsoptimiser_list_characters or adsoptimiser_create_character.

include_thumbnails.description: Attach small preview images (384px JPEG) of the character's reference images (up to 5) so you can see them. Default true.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_view_image
tools.description: See one image at a larger size (768, 1024, 1536 px; default 1024) to check detail: colours, small features, text, or the views on a character sheet. Previews in other tools are small (384px). Pass exactly one of job_id, key, or character_id with image_index. Use crop to zoom into a region: fractions of the original image, e.g. { x: 0.3, y: 0.5, width: 0.4, height: 0.3 }. For characters, prefer separate images per view: each shows far more detail than one sheet holding many views. Only in this package: save_to also saves the returned image to a local folder. Uses no allowance.

job_id.description: A finished image job (or a video job with a poster frame).

key.description: A media storage key in this workspace, e.g. the part of a media URL after /media/.

character_id.description: A saved character; pass image_index to choose which reference image.

image_index.description: Which of the character's reference images, 1 to 5 (as listed by adsoptimiser_get_character).

size.description: Longest side in px: 768, 1024, 1536. Default 1024. Images are never upscaled.

crop.description: Zoom into a region: fractions of the original image, applied before scaling. x + width and y + height must not exceed 1. Example { x: 0.3, y: 0.5, width: 0.4, height: 0.3 }.

x.description: Left edge, as a fraction of the original width.

y.description: Top edge, as a fraction of the original height.

width.description: Width, as a fraction of the original (at least 0.05).

height.description: Height, as a fraction of the original (at least 0.05).

save_to.description: Also save the returned image in this local folder (created if missing). Use "" for the default ./adsoptimiser-output (or ADSOPTIMISER_OUTPUT_DIR). Existing files are never replaced.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_list_character_assets
tools.description: List everything made with a saved character, newest first: images, videos, talking clips, lip-syncs, voiceovers and captioned clips, with result URLs, the kept speech audio (speech_url) and the line spoken (script) where there is one. Filter by type and page with cursor. Pass include_thumbnails to see small previews of up to 6 finished images on the page. Only in this package: with download_to, the listed finished files (media and speech mp3s) are also saved to that local folder, at most 20 per call, and existing files are never replaced.

character_id.description: A character id from adsoptimiser_list_characters or adsoptimiser_create_character.

type.description: Only this kind: image, video, talking (Grok video speaking a preset voice), lip_sync, voiceover or captions.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous call, for the next (older) page.

download_to.description: Also save the listed finished assets (images, videos and kept speech mp3s) in this local folder (created if missing), at most 20 files per call. Use "" for the default ./adsoptimiser-output (or ADSOPTIMISER_OUTPUT_DIR). Existing files are never replaced.

include_thumbnails.description: Attach small preview images (384px JPEG) of up to 6 finished images on this page (videos are not previewed) so you can see them. Default false.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_create_character
tools.description: Save a consistent character from 1 to 5 reference images: job_ids of finished image jobs (usually the best shots of a character sheet: front, three-quarter and side angles, a full-body shot and a close-up on a neutral white background with realistic skin), https image_urls, and/or image_paths (local files, checked and uploaded for you). Add a description (age, face, hair, build, persona) and optionally style notes and a voice (adsoptimiser_list_voices; audition it with adsoptimiser_preview_voice). Then pass the character_id to adsoptimiser_generate_image for new scenes and to adsoptimiser_generate_video for talking clips. Uses no generation allowance. Needs member (not viewer) role. Characters cannot be deleted from here; delete them in the app.

description.description: Appearance and persona notes added to every prompt that uses the character, e.g. '101-year-old man, shaved head, long white beard, warm farmer's hands'.

style.description: Look/style notes, e.g. 'realistic skin texture, natural light, not airbrushed'.

image_paths.description: Local image files (absolute paths; png, jpg, webp or gif, max 10 MB each) to upload and save as reference images.

image_urls.description: https URLs of the character's reference images (e.g. media_url values).

job_ids.description: Finished image jobs to save as reference images (the best shots of a character sheet).

voice.description: The character's voice (adsoptimiser_list_voices): an xAI preset, an OpenAI voice with instructions, or a cloned ElevenLabs voice, the last two used for voiceovers and lip-sync (talking videos then use xai_voice_id, else eve). null clears it.

voice_id.description: xAI preset (adsoptimiser_list_voices), e.g. eve, leo, rex.

instructions.description: How to speak: accent, emotion, intonation, pacing, tone, e.g. 'slow, warm, gravelly, rural American accent'.

xai_voice_id.description: xAI preset talking videos use for this character (they cannot speak OpenAI voices). Default eve.

voice_id.description: A cloned voice listed for this workspace by adsoptimiser_list_voices (ElevenLabs voice id, e.g. a real person's voice).

xai_voice_id.description: xAI preset talking videos use for this character (they cannot speak ElevenLabs voices). Default eve.

anyOf.description: A voice profile: an xAI preset, an OpenAI voice with delivery instructions, or an ElevenLabs cloned voice (narration, lip-sync and previews).

default_voice_id.description: Shorthand for voice { provider: xai, voice_id } (see adsoptimiser_list_voices), e.g. eve, leo or rex.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_update_character
tools.description: Change a saved character's name, description, style, voice or reference images. Passing image_paths, image_urls and/or job_ids replaces the whole image list (1 to 5 images; adsoptimiser_get_character shows the current URLs, so include the ones to keep). For iterations like 'make him older', generate new images with the character as reference, then save the best ones here. Uses no generation allowance. Characters cannot be deleted from here; delete them in the app.

character_id.description: A character id from adsoptimiser_list_characters or adsoptimiser_create_character.

description.description: Appearance and persona notes added to every prompt that uses the character, e.g. '101-year-old man, shaved head, long white beard, warm farmer's hands'.

style.description: Look/style notes, e.g. 'realistic skin texture, natural light, not airbrushed'.

image_paths.description: Local image files (absolute paths; png, jpg, webp or gif, max 10 MB each) to upload and save as reference images.

image_urls.description: https URLs of the character's reference images (e.g. media_url values).

job_ids.description: Finished image jobs to save as reference images (the best shots of a character sheet).

voice.description: The character's voice (adsoptimiser_list_voices): an xAI preset, an OpenAI voice with instructions, or a cloned ElevenLabs voice, the last two used for voiceovers and lip-sync (talking videos then use xai_voice_id, else eve). null clears it.

voice_id.description: xAI preset (adsoptimiser_list_voices), e.g. eve, leo, rex.

instructions.description: How to speak: accent, emotion, intonation, pacing, tone, e.g. 'slow, warm, gravelly, rural American accent'.

xai_voice_id.description: xAI preset talking videos use for this character (they cannot speak OpenAI voices). Default eve.

voice_id.description: A cloned voice listed for this workspace by adsoptimiser_list_voices (ElevenLabs voice id, e.g. a real person's voice).

xai_voice_id.description: xAI preset talking videos use for this character (they cannot speak ElevenLabs voices). Default eve.

anyOf.description: A voice profile: an xAI preset, an OpenAI voice with delivery instructions, or an ElevenLabs cloned voice (narration, lip-sync and previews).

default_voice_id.description: Shorthand for voice { provider: xai, voice_id } (see adsoptimiser_list_voices), e.g. eve, leo or rex.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_list_voices
tools.description: List the voices: xAI presets (talking videos, voiceovers, a character's default_voice_id), OpenAI gpt-4o-mini-tts voices (voiceovers and previews, steered with instructions such as accent, pacing and tone) and this workspace's cloned ElevenLabs voices (voiceovers, lip-sync and previews), plus which providers are configured. Read-only.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_preview_voice
tools.description: Synthesise a short sample (at most 300 characters) in a voice profile and return a playable audio URL, e.g. to audition an OpenAI voice with instructions before saving it to a character. Pass character_id to file it in that character's voice preview history (shown on its Characters page). With save_to, the mp3 is also saved to that local folder so the user can play it. Creates no job and uses no plan allowance; limited to 10 previews a minute, and repeats of the same voice and text are served from cache.

voice_id.description: xAI preset (adsoptimiser_list_voices), e.g. eve, leo, rex.

instructions.description: How to speak: accent, emotion, intonation, pacing, tone, e.g. 'slow, warm, gravelly, rural American accent'.

xai_voice_id.description: xAI preset talking videos use for this character (they cannot speak OpenAI voices). Default eve.

voice_id.description: A cloned voice listed for this workspace by adsoptimiser_list_voices (ElevenLabs voice id, e.g. a real person's voice).

xai_voice_id.description: xAI preset talking videos use for this character (they cannot speak ElevenLabs voices). Default eve.

voice.description: A voice profile: an xAI preset, an OpenAI voice with delivery instructions, or an ElevenLabs cloned voice (narration, lip-sync and previews).

text.description: What to say (at most 300 characters). Omit for a default sample line.

character_id.description: Record the preview in this character's voice preview history.

save_to.description: Also save the sample as an mp3 in this local folder (created if missing) so the user can play it. Use "" for the default ./adsoptimiser-output (or ADSOPTIMISER_OUTPUT_DIR).

tools.name: adsoptimiser_upload_file
tools.description: Upload a local image (png, jpg, webp, gif; max 10 MB) or video (mp4, mov; max 120 MB) to Ads Optimiser and return its hosted URL, for use as reference_image_urls or source_image_url. Uses no plan allowance.

path.description: Absolute path of a local image (png, jpg, webp, gif; max 10 MB) or video (mp4, mov; max 120 MB).

purpose.description: Videos only: extend accepts source videos up to 15s instead of 8.7s.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_download_job
tools.description: Save a finished job's image or video to a local folder (default ./adsoptimiser-output). The file is named after the job id and prompt, and an existing file is never replaced unless overwrite is true.

folder.description: Folder to save into (created if missing). Defaults to ./adsoptimiser-output, or ADSOPTIMISER_OUTPUT_DIR when set.

overwrite.description: Replace a file with the same name. Default false: a numbered name is used instead.

tools.name: adsoptimiser_batch_generate
tools.description: Queue one job per local image in a folder (image_to_video or image_edit) or per line of a prompts file (prompts). At most 10 per call; each job uses plan allowance like a single generation. Stops at a plan limit, quota or rate limit and reports what was queued and the offset to resume from. Returns job ids at once; check them with adsoptimiser_get_job or adsoptimiser_list_jobs.

mode.description: image_to_video: one video per image in `folder`. image_edit: one edited image per image in `folder`. prompts: one job per line of `prompts_file`.

folder.description: Folder of images (png, jpg, webp, gif) for the image modes.

prompts_file.description: Text file with one prompt per line (blank lines and # comments skipped).

prompt.description: Image modes: the instruction applied to every image. Required for them.

asset_type.description: prompts mode only: generate images (default) or videos.

quality.description: Images only. Grok Image 2.0: low, medium or auto. OpenAI models: low, medium (default), high or auto.

max_items.description: How many to queue in this call (default and maximum 10).

offset.description: Skip this many items first, to resume a batch that stopped.

instructions: Ads Optimiser generates TikTok ad images and videos with Grok, and images also with OpenAI GPT Image 2.5 where the deployment offers it (gpt-image-2.5-sunburst follows detailed specs closely). If a tool says it is not connected, call adsoptimiser_connect and give the user the URL and code; after they approve in the browser, call adsoptimiser_finish_connect. Every generation uses the workspace's monthly plan allowance, so confirm before generating many at once. Local files: pass absolute paths. Use adsoptimiser_download_job to save finished media to disk. For a consistent AI person (influencer, brand ambassador): generate a character sheet, save the best shots with adsoptimiser_create_character (local files via image_paths), then pass character_id to adsoptimiser_generate_image, adsoptimiser_generate_video or adsoptimiser_run_pipeline. Audition voices with adsoptimiser_preview_voice. adsoptimiser_get_character summarises what was made with a character; adsoptimiser_list_character_assets lists it all and saves files locally with download_to. For a talking clip in a designed (OpenAI) or cloned (ElevenLabs) voice, lip-sync a finished clip where the character is not already talking with adsoptimiser_lip_sync (model sync-lipsync-2-pro for the best lips), or run the character-lip-sync template. To put text on any finished video (title cards timed to spoken moments, or captions timed to the speech with auto_captions), use adsoptimiser_add_overlays: it works on any existing video, with no need to regenerate it or run a pipeline. To build a pipeline: call adsoptimiser_get_pipeline_nodes first, use only the node types it lists, keep to 12 nodes, and check the graph with adsoptimiser_validate_pipeline before saving or running it.
